review.tagline: Six Agent Skills for design, video, image and retrieval tasks
review.summary: Garden Skills is a set of SKILL.md-format skills for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and other coding agents. The six skills cover web video presentations (Vite, React, TypeScript, 23 themes, pluggable TTS), front-end design, GPT Image 2 prompting and generation, article formatting, code-rendered short video, and local knowledge retrieval. Install options include the skills CLI via npx, the Claude Code plugin marketplace, release zips, manual copy or a git submodule.
review.audience: Developers who want ready-made skills for Claude Code, Cursor or Codex
strengths: Follows the SKILL.md spec, so it works across Claude Code, Cursor and Codex
Five install paths, including pinned per-skill release zips
web-design-engineer ships 25 style recipes and a design direction advisor
gpt-image-2 includes 79 prompt templates and three runtime modes
weaknesses: Skills are narrow: design, video, images and articles, not general coding
gpt-image-2 local mode needs an image API; key setup not shown in the visible README
Built-in TTS providers are only MiniMax and OpenAI; others are paste-in snippets
README is truncated, so details of three skills (article, showreel, kb-retriever) are unknown
needs: Needs Node.js (npx), OpenAI-compatible image API (gpt-image-2), MiniMax mmx-cli or OpenAI TTS (optional)
Models: GPT Image 2, OpenAI-compatible image APIs
